coordinate_system.description: Normalized Cartesian coordinates from ThermoCorr image pixels.

reaction_boundary.description: Scaled measured force attached to top vertical DOFs.

reaction_scaling.description: The default pixel_height mode divides force_vfm by the raw ThermoCorr y-span so the normalized-coordinate weak form has the same coefficient scale as raw pixel coordinates. Pass physical_height and thickness to obtain stress-like units.
